page.overview:
Who is Mikio Itoo?

Mikio Itoo is a background joke character created by Eiichiro Oda, and arguably the first Easter Egg featured in One Piece.

He is a caricature of , a -born manga creator whom Oda knew as a fellow assistant to . Like Oda, Ito went on to publish his own series in Weekly Shonen Jump, such as and .

Within One Piece, Itoo is a wanted gunman with a bounty of ¥1 million (unknown how much this is in belly).

Thus far, Itoo has "appeared" mostly on wanted posters scattered throughout areas of the East Blue. These tend to vary greatly in detail; the most detailed depicts him as a man with an untidy mop of brown hair and matching beard.
